meta.label: Trust in hcw
meta.description: Perceived welcome and quality of interaction at the health centre during the last visit.

meta.label: Affordability
meta.description: Out-of-pocket costs households face for vaccination (e.g. paying for the vaccination card).

meta.label: Missed opportunities
meta.description: Past instances where a child was brought to a health centre for vaccination but not vaccinated.

meta.label: Ease to vaccinate children
meta.description: Perceived ease of obtaining vaccination services for one's child.

meta.label: Outreach
meta.description: Frequency of home visits from community outreach workers.

meta.label: Community norms
meta.description: Belief that most parents in the community vaccinate their children.

meta.label: Fear side effects
meta.description: Reported awareness of children who experienced side effects (e.g. abscess) after vaccination.

meta.label: Opinion on vaccines
meta.description: Perceived importance of vaccines for the child's health.

meta.label: Self efficacy
meta.description: Caregiver's confidence in their ability to bring the child to scheduled vaccination sessions.

meta.label: Knowledge diseases
meta.description: Knowledge of which childhood illnesses can be prevented by vaccination.

meta.label: Knowledge vaccines
meta.description: Knowledge of vaccination logistics — campaigns, dates, target age groups.

meta.label: Household travel ohe
meta.description: Whether household members lived or travelled away from home in the past year.

meta.label: Is max ethnic group
meta.description: Cultural alignment between the respondent's ethnic group and the dominant group of the zone.
